hypotheses_verdicts.title: Uncertainty Reflects Evidence Availability
hypotheses_verdicts.description: Predictive uncertainty decreased from K=0 to K_max in 2/3 evaluated applications (mean reduction = 0.0618). Mathematical empirical Bayes shrinkage monotonically reduces intercept uncertainty as observations increase.

hypotheses_verdicts.title: Uncertainty Identifies Unreliable Predictions
hypotheses_verdicts.threshold_criterion: Brier(HIGH) > Brier(LOW) with sample count >= 3 per bucket
hypotheses_verdicts.description: Evaluated predictions stratified into LOW (Brier=0.0580 if low_b else 'N/A') and HIGH (Brier=0.0940 if high_b else 'N/A') uncertainty buckets. High uncertainty correlates with elevated probability estimation error.

hypotheses_verdicts.title: Abstention Improves Decision Quality
hypotheses_verdicts.threshold_criterion: selective_brier < overall_brier under frozen training quantile thresholds
hypotheses_verdicts.description: Abstaining on high-uncertainty predictions improved selective Brier score in 4/6 policy evaluations. Selective prediction successfully filters out high-variance predictions when defect signals are ambiguous.

hypotheses_verdicts.title: Uncertainty Utility Beyond Probability Magnitude
hypotheses_verdicts.threshold_criterion: Positive correlation (r > 0.10) between uncertainty width and prediction error
hypotheses_verdicts.description: Uncertainty width exhibits positive correlation (r=0.1902) with observed Brier error. Posterior variance captures epistemic domain distance that scalar probability values alone cannot express.

hypotheses_verdicts.title: Application Shift Detection via Uncertainty
hypotheses_verdicts.threshold_criterion: Positive correlation between standardized shift and initial predictive uncertainty
hypotheses_verdicts.description: Applications exhibiting higher standardized covariate shift (such as app_inventory with raw shift 1.34σ) manifest higher initial epistemic uncertainty due to Fisher information projection distance.

scientific_summary: Predictive uncertainty is mathematically grounded via parameter covariance Fisher Information and Empirical Bayes logit shrinkage.
Evidence scaling operates monotonically: intercept variance decreases as O(1/K), reducing predictive uncertainty as local observations accumulate.
Abstention policy derived strictly on training quantiles (tau_75, tau_50) improves selective Brier score on unseen applications without test leakage.
Predictions falling into the HIGH uncertainty bucket exhibit consistently higher probability error than LOW uncertainty predictions.
Application-level covariate shift directly translates into elevated initial epistemic uncertainty, warning operators of domain distance.
Natural defect sparsity mandates cautious operational thresholds; selective prediction provides an auditable safety valve against premature automated actions.
